texts.text:
Why Generic AI
Breaks in GameDev
texts.fontFamily: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "system-ui", "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

texts.text: File-scoped AI produces syntactically valid code — but has no view of engine semantics, asset dependency graphs, or delivery constraints that determine whether a change is actually shippable.
